headline: Novaya Gazeta Sets Nov. 9 Closure in Russia
deck: The newspaper says an eviction from its Moscow offices will end its remaining operations in Russia on 9 November.
body: Novaya Gazeta said it would end its remaining operations in Russia on 9 November after an eviction from its long-time Moscow offices. [E1]

A 31 October report had already said Russian authorities and intelligence services forced the paper to stop; the new announcement adds the closure date and the eviction from its Moscow office. [E3][E1]
The newspaper said its websites and print edition had been blocked, its media licence revoked and staff designated as “foreign agents” before the closure announcement. [E2]
The newspaper said it would turn off its servers and leave its 30-year home on 9 November. [E4]

evidence_box.fragment: Novaya Gazeta stated on 30 October 2026 that it would shut down its remaining operations in Russia on 9 November, citing forced eviction from its long-time Moscow offices.
